text: Sinno ɓee noddiraynooɓe ma an Nulaaɗo, ka ɓaawo cuuɗi rewɓe maa ɓen muññino haa yawtaa tawaa ɓe, ontuma ɓe yewtire sowtooji joltuɗi, ko ɗum ɓuraynoo moƴƴannde ɓe dii noddirgol maa ɓaawo, tawde ko tintodugol e maa ngol wonndi e teddungal. Allah non ko Haforoowo junuubi kala tuubuɗo e maɓɓe e wanaa kamɓe sabu majjeede maɓɓe, Hinnotooɗo ɓe kadi.
